providers.notes: AitoearnLocalPlatformBridge is wired in main.ts:179, so provider-registry.ts:72-86 reports the provider as enabled. Video publish covers all four platforms. Image-text publish exists upstream only for xhs (xiaohongshu/index.ts:812) and douyin (douyin/index.ts:664); shipinhao and Kwai expose video-only publish APIs, so lib/self-media/capabilities.ts keeps their supportsImageText false. scheduledPublish is MYStudio-side: task-runtime holds the task until scheduledAt, then self-media-ipc.ts:231-233 strips scheduledAt before calling the bridge, because platform-bridge.ts:232 rejects native platform scheduling. taskPolling stays false because the local publish is synchronous and platform-bridge.ts:289 only echoes the stored task status. Cancellation fails closed at platform-bridge.ts:290. The sharp shim replaces the native module imported by vendor plat/utils/index.ts:2, which is used only to read image width/height, so the packaged main bundle carries no .node binary.
